channel.description: Metadata Editor User Guide It’s main purpose is to make metadata editing simple and thus this guide also will be simple. Key information Editor works best with one asset at a time but you can use it to apply same metadata to multiple assets as well. Edit metadata of an asset 1. Opening the editor. Pick an asset of choice in Content Browser and Right Mouse Button on it. Navigate to Asset Actions -> Metadata Editor 2.
